claim: Answer: FTMS lets a fitness machine send training data to an app; the SIG's page lists version 1.0.1.
quote: This service exposes training-related data in the sports and fitness environment, which allows a Server (e.g., a fitness machine) to send training-related data to a Client.

claim: Answer / body: the specification's introduction: the client collects training data while a user exercises on the machine.
quote: The Fitness Machine Service (FTMS) exposes training-related data in the sports and fitness environment, which allows a Client to collect training data while a user is exercising with a fitness machine (Server).

claim: Body: Training Status sends training status to the app, e.g. warming up or a low or high intensity phase.
quote: The Training Status characteristic shall be used by the Server to send the training status information to the Client.

claim: Body: training status examples.
quote: in order to provide feedback to the Client about training status (e.g., warming up, low or high intensity phase,

claim: Capability discovery: Fitness Machine Feature describes the supported features.
quote: The Fitness Machine Feature characteristic shall be used to describe the supported features of the Server.

claim: Control point: the Control Point is used to request a function on the machine.
quote: The Fitness Machine Control Point characteristic is used to request a specific function to be executed on the Server.

claim: Control point: the Control Point provides a way to remotely control the machine.
quote: The Fitness Machine Control Point may also be exposed by the Server in order to provide a mechanism to remotely control a fitness machine (e.g., start, stop, increase the speed, etc.)

claim: Control point: Fitness Machine Status reports machine status such as started or stopped by the user.
quote: the service may also expose the Fitness Machine Status characteristic to send information to the Client about the status of the machine (e.g., started by the user, stopped by the user, etc.)

claim: Control point: every control procedure requires control permission from the machine.
quote: requires control permission from the Server.

claim: Control point: after Request Control returns Success, the machine allows the other control procedures.
quote: When the Request Control Op Code is written to the Fitness Machine Control Point and the Result Code is ‘Success’, the Server shall allow the Client to perform any supported control procedures

claim: Capability discovery: Supported Speed Range represents the speed range a fitness machine supports.
quote: The Supported Speed Range characteristic is used to represent the speed range supported by a fitness machine.
